description: Start a containerized game server session on the Gameye platform. Returns the session ID, host and ports. Starts a billable session in the environment shown in the result prefix. When no ttl is given, a 30m TTL is applied and reported. The label launched-by=gameye-mcp is always sent and replaces any launched-by value you pass; if a warm pool serves the image and region, the server ignores request labels (and env and args), so warm-pool sessions do not carry it. The launch is refused, with nothing sent, if any env value, arg or label contains this server's Gameye API token. Pass dryRun=true to preview the request.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the container entrypoint

dryRun.description: Return the exact request that would be sent, with the API token masked, and send nothing

env.description: Environment variables passed to the container

id.description: Custom session ID; auto-generated if omitted. IDs are unique across all of Gameye, so derive it from a UUID. A 409 whose describe returns 404 means another customer owns the ID: retry with a fresh one. Warm-pool launches ignore it; always read the ID from the result

restart.description: Automatically restart the container on exit

ttl.description: Session time-to-live, e.g. '1h', '30m'. Session auto-stops after this duration. Defaults to 30m

name: gameye_launch_session
title: Launch session
